sources.facts: 12 nm, 0.8 V, 1.26 GHz, standalone wDotp FPU 0.019 mm2, FP8 20.2 GFLOPS and 1631 GFLOPS/W. Supports FP16/FP16alt, FP8 E5M2/FP8alt E4M3; FP16alt has BF16 bit fields. Integrated FPU also supports FP32/64.
sources.image_consistency: FP8 area 20.2/1000/0.019 = 1.06316; energy 1631/1000 = 1.631, consistent with image. FP16 area 8 FLOP/cycle *1.26 GHz /0.019 mm2 = 0.530526. FP16 energy 0.82 retained from supplied comparison image, not independently extracted as a primary measurement.

sources.derivation: Area efficiencies estimated from (GFLOPS/1000)/(6000/1e6); no technology conversion. Not 100x100 um floorplan area. Not average local-FPnew ratio multiplied by 22 nm full SIMD FPU efficiency.
